competingNavigationReview.directTrace: No Playwright goto/reload/goBack after the native tap; no close action until timeout teardown. No recorded crash or controller-change/service-worker signal.

competingNavigationReview.runtimeHistoryHypothesis: reloadProfile sets started=false before location.reload. Capture-phase click listener queues syncMenuHistory; its guard excludes only navigationAway/document.hidden, while pagehide sets navigationAway later. preload.qualification: Instrumented repeat: native calls pass through Reflect.apply, original test/actions/assertions/20,000ms deadline unchanged; init script, stack capture, console transfer and synchronous file recording have nonzero observer overhead.

selectionError.qualification: Initial anchored grep selected no cases. Kept separately; contributes zero executed cases and zero passes.

findings: All four exact narrow-phone cases passed with no retry. Post-reload welcome, hidden Resume Saved, final five-domain equality and importing-tab error assertion were reached in these repeats; those assertions remain blocked in the original full timeout.

Each context records one history.go(-1), followed by popstate, during earlier setup. It precedes Reload by 3336.2 to 3784.3 browser ms. No history.go is recorded between the Reload capture click and new document initialization in any repeat.

Every Reload records trusted capture/bubble click, uncancelled beforeunload before and after app handlers, successful document GET, new document, document-finished and load. Node receipt click-to-load spans 217 to 330ms.
No failed document request, pageerror, crash, observer parse error or limit marker is retained. All 588 JSONL lines parse across four observed contexts plus preload-only process files.

The old document pagehide at each successful Reload is not retained. Only later final-close pagehide events on different document origins appear. Console transfer across document teardown is incomplete; this absence is not proof that pagehide or the app handler did not run.

raceHypothesis.status: Unconfirmed; not observed in these four successful instrumented repeats.
raceHypothesis.sourceSupportedPossibility: Original reloadProfile changes started=false then location.reload while capture click queues syncMenuHistory; a history traversal could theoretically compete before departure guards. Original trace has no native history instrumentation.
raceHypothesis.whatRepeatsEstablish: Earlier setup traversal is observed and settled before Reload. Successful repeat unload is uncancelled and no traversal is recorded near Reload.
raceHypothesis.whatRepeatsDoNotEstablish: They neither reproduce nor disprove a rare competing traversal in the original failure, identify infrastructure as its cause, establish data loss, or erase the original timeout.

limits: Instrumented successful repeat evidence is separate from the original unchanged full run. No aggregate passing count substitutes for the original 1,590 passed / one timedOut / 49 skipped.
Browser documentTime deltas are used only within the same timeOrigin. Node receipt deltas include console/protocol delivery latency; they are chronology evidence, not precise native request timing.
Observer logs can be lost during unload; initial about:blank install is also not captured. No marker or warning does not prove every potential event was delivered.

No dialog listener was added, preserving Playwright default dismissal behavior. No direct service-worker controller-change recording was added; automatic app service-worker registration excludes this HTTP 127.0.0.1 origin.
Four two-worker Chromium repeats do not cover physical mobile hardware, other browser engines or rare timing distributions.

source.mechanism: reloadProfile app.js:3169-3177 sets allowProfileReload=true and started=false then location.reload. beforeunload app.js:2047 permits that reload. syncMenuHistory app.js:198 guards navigationAway/document.hidden, not allowProfileReload. Trail app.js:3673 removes started battle depth; menu-history.js:87-94 may call history.go for shortened trail. Departure guard app.js:3826 sets navigationAway on pagehide, which is observed only at timeout teardown after cancellation/popstate.
source.triggerLimit: Stack proves syncMenuHistory -> menu-history sync -> native go. It does not identify which queued callback or observer invoked syncMenuHistory.

conclusion.observed: 4/4 altered-schedule cases directly record app history.go(-1) during correctly targeted explicit Reload response hold, cancellation of the same reload request (ERR_ABORTED/canceled:true), native historySameDocument navigation, popstate within the original timeOrigin, then original load timeout.
conclusion.strength: Competing-history cancellation mechanism is directly observed and repeatable under this intervention. The later Invalid InterceptionId continuation error follows cancellation and does not show continueResponse initiated it.
conclusion.originalGateCausality: Not proven for the original uninstrumented timeout. Matching symptom and source-supported path strengthen the hypothesis, but original trace lacks native history instrumentation; do not claim exact original causality or newly introduced d0 source regression.
conclusion.completionLimit: Four cancellations during targeted holds are not four fully completed250/750ms holds. No further browser execution requested.

limits: Fetch response interception deliberately alters scheduling; CDP, stack/console and synchronous-file recording add observer overhead. Unarmed documents also incur immediate interception/continuation overhead. This is separate from the gate.

No production/test source, original action/assertion/storage value/deadline was edited. No forced click, request retry, body read/fulfillment, header/status override, cache bypass or dialog listener was added.
Browser time deltas use same timeOrigin only. Node receipt hold deltas include protocol delivery. Native request-to-failure uses Network timestamps.

Relevant handler/history blocks and entire menu-history module are byte-identical to46. Previously passing identities do not isolate whether d0 layout changes affect timing.
No physical mobile/controller, installed PWA or non-Chromium coverage.
